review.brief:
SCOPE: git diff b5aab47..HEAD -- internal/analytics/ cmd/web/main.go cmd/poller/main.go (tier-3 commits only: 4b4b3f5, 95f2b76, 13e9939, 8e4aa00). Read the DIFF, not the whole module. Tier 2 (internal/charging) was reviewed and archived already - out of scope.

VALIDATE:
1. Module boundaries (ai/architecture.md): analytics consumes charging ONLY through the public charging.SuperchargerSessionAnalyticsReader port; no cross-module DB access; cmd/ stays thin. Confirm cmd/poller deliberately keeps TWO Supercharger ports (decision D6) and that the telemetry one still feeds app.NewProcessor's mirror step - a straight swap there would silently break the mirror.
2. DB design match (BLOCKER on mismatch): 20260828000001_migrate_vehicle_metric_watermarks_source.sql must match design.md 2e exactly. Up = DROP CHECK, DELETE (never UPDATE) rows with source='supercharger_sessions', re-add 3-value CHECK, refresh COMMENTs (decisions D1/D2). Down = DELETE source='charge_sessions' BEFORE restoring the old CHECK, with its rationale comment intact (decision D8 - without it Down fails SQLSTATE 23514 in production). Sibling watermark sources (vehicle_snapshots, manual_charge_entries) must be untouched.
3. Test-contract rule: integration tests must assert design.md 5's PINNED values T1-T4, not whatever the implementation produces. Specifically: T1 asserts the supercharger_sessions watermark is GONE not renamed, the epoch read, and still-gone after the Down round-trip; T3 asserts consumed_pct == 75 AND explicitly != 45 (the negative assertion IS the test); T2 asserts the OLD telemetry method names are never invoked; T4 is the nil-TeslaID non-regression. Flag any assertion reverse-engineered from the code.
4. tasks.md Acceptance clauses: every one of 1.1-1.4, 2.1-2.4 actually met. Note 2.4 was leader-appended (decision D5) for analytics.go's stale package doc - CLAUDE.md requires docs to track structural change in the SAME change.
5. Doc-pack conventions: CLAUDE.md non-negotiables (unit suffixes, modular packages, docs-track-change, bilingual i18n where user-facing), ai/go-conventions.md, internal/analytics/AGENTS.md (its own import list must now be accurate - zero telemetry.SuperchargerReader / telemetry.SuperchargerSession references).
6. Performance-Profile compliance (read-heavy, verbatim in the dispatch).
7. Anti-gaming: no tasks.md acceptance criterion weakened, edited or deleted; no test skipped, t.Skip'd or loosened to pass; no status self-approved; no assistant claiming a suite result.
